description: This file defines the SmsClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used to interact with the AWS Server Migration Service. It includes method annotations for various operations related to app management, replication, and server catalog handling.

classes.name: SmsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Server Migration Service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new application in the AWS Server Migration Service.

methods.name: createReplicationJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new replication job.

methods.name: deleteAppLaunchConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the launch configuration for an app.

methods.name: deleteAppLaunchConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the app launch configuration.

methods.name: deleteAppReplicationConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the replication configuration for an app.

methods.name: deleteAppReplicationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the app replication configuration.

methods.name: deleteAppValidationConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the validation configuration for an app.

methods.name: deleteAppValidationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the app validation configuration.

methods.name: getAppLaunchConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the launch configuration of an app.

methods.name: getAppLaunchConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the app launch configuration.

methods.name: getAppReplicationConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the replication configuration of an app.

methods.name: getAppReplicationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the app replication configuration.

methods.name: getAppValidationConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the validation configuration of an app.

methods.name: getAppValidationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the app validation configuration.

methods.name: getAppValidationOutput
methods.description: Retrieves validation output for an app.

methods.name: notifyAppValidationOutput
methods.description: Notifies validation output for an app.

methods.name: putAppLaunchConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the app launch configuration.

methods.name: putAppReplicationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the app replication configuration.

methods.name: putAppValidationConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the app validation configuration.

methods.name: startOnDemandReplicationRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts an on-demand replication run.
